items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 May 2026 12:43pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 06 May 2026 at 12:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Weak ridge of high pressure over Scotland and the North Sea with a developing area of low pressure to the south of Iceland.


##Wind##

Southeast 3 or 4, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area at first, backing southerly 3 or 4 overnight, but southeast 5 occasionally 6 in the east of the area for a time overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, mainly in the west.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or south-southwest 4 or 5, becoming variable 3 or less on Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
